request.spec:

member, pools in the order added and members in the order added, a pool member as pool:<name>, the
cut as shown (empty when none).

agent.result_text:
I added an "Export pools CSV" button (`data-testid="export-pools"`) to the Pools section, and `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests in the spec.

When pressed, it first re-reads the pools from the store, then downloads `pools.csv`:
- The header line is `pool,member,share,cut`.
- Then there is one line per member, with pools and members in the order they were added.
- A pool that is a member of another pool is written as `pool:<name>`.
- The cut is exactly what the screen shows: empty when there is none, and it follows the server's figures after someone retires.
- Fields with a comma, quote or line break are quoted, so `Lee, Jo` comes out as `"Lee, Jo"`.

The change is only in the front end; the server already returned everything the export needs. I also moved the CSV-writing helpers out of `features/people/people.ts` into a new shared file, `core/csv.ts`, so the people export and the pools export use the same code. The people export works as before.
